text:
alex.nguyen: Heads up — drift detector just flagged a policy violation during nightly reconcile for gpu-nodepool in prod. OPA check failed: label mismatch between git and cloud.
infra-bot: [reconcile] gitops/cluster-prod failed: resource: google_container_node_pool/gpu-np, reason: policy.denied (labels.owner missing)
samir: link to log?
alex.nguyen: https://gitops.redwood.internal/logs/1801239999 — short excerpt: 
```
Plan: 0 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy.
~ resource "google_container_node_pool" "gpu-np" {
    labels = {
      "env" = "prod"
-     "owner" = "ml-team"
+     # owner label absent
    }
}
```
zoe: OPA gate is `policies/required-owner-label` — we enforce owner label for billing and oncall routing.
maria: Is this a staging->prod merge that missed the label? Might be a Helm values vs Terraform mismatch again.
alex.nguyen: Looks like prod nodepool was patched manually last week to increase min_size for a burst. Patch removed the label. git shows no corresponding change.
samir: Do we have a remediation automation? auto-reconcile turned off for prod nodepools last quarter.
infra-bot: autoclaimer status: disabled for resource scope=production/nodepools per policy team request.
zoe: If we patch prod to match git, we lose the manual scaling change. We need to either add label in git or reapply patch + label. What did the manual change do?
alex.nguyen: It bumped min_node_count from 1 -> 4 for higher GPU capacity during the weekend jobs.
maria: Cost hit is non-trivial if that stays. We should revert the scale or update git to reflect the new min. Which is the approved flow?
samir: Approvals: changes to prod nodepool size must go through infra-ops with cost signoff. I can open a quick PR to add the label + source note, but we need cost approval.
alex.nguyen: Can we quarantine the reconcile until cost signoff lands? Right now OPA blocks the reconcile and GitOps won't continue to other resources.
infra-bot: action required: reconcile blocked by policy at 1801239999. To proceed, either: (1) add required label in git and open approval ticket, or (2) set a temporary policy-exception (requires infra-ops+security).
zoe: Option 1 is safer. Samir, can you draft the PR with the bump + label and include cost delta?
samir: on it. PR branch: hotfix/prod-gpu-owner-1801. Will include terraform change and a note: "manual scaling observed on 2026-01-25; reconciling state".
maria: Also add a Helm values check: `helm get values ml-gpu-pool -n infra` — there was previously a separate helm hook that annotated autoscaler. If helm still has older values, we'll get continuous churn.
alex.nguyen: Running quick checks:
```
kubectl get nodes -l cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool=gpu-np -o wide
NAME                       STATUS   ROLES    AGE    VERSION
gke-prod-gpu-np-abc123     Ready    <none>   3d     v1.27.4
```
alex.nguyen: helm values show `replicaCount: 0` (that's a config for a helper chart, unrelated) — main change is Terraform nodepool min_size.
zoe: If PR goes in, GitOps will try to apply and should pass OPA. But since the cloud state already has min=4, Terraform plan will be no-op except the label addition, correct?
samir: Plan shows it will only update labels. Will not scale.
maria: Cost: bumping committed nodes isn't part of the PR so finance impact is the existing manual patch. We should annotate infra ticket for chargeback to ml-team.
alex.nguyen: Quick ask: can we enable a temporary exemption for the reconcile so that other independent resources can progress? Right now the blocked resource is early in the tree and prevents downstream services from updating.
infra-bot: policy-exception request flow: create ticket in infra-ops with tag `policy-exempt` and include owner signatures from security + infra leads.
zoe: That's heavy. Prefer to unblock by aligning git asap. Samir, ETA?
samir: PR in 25m. I'll request `@maria` for cost ack and `@alex.nguyen` for infra ack in the PR description.
maria: I'll review as soon as PR is up. If it's just label + note, LGTM.
alex.nguyen: After merge we'll trigger `gitops-sync --env prod --target gpu-np` and monitor reconcile logs. If anything else pops up, we revert.
deploy-bot: action triggered: manual-sync requested by alex.nguyen for resource gpu-np at 1801240200.
zoe: Also let's add a post-incident item: enable an automated drift alert that distinguishes label-only drift vs capacity drift. Right now everything looks identical in alerts.
samir: Good idea. I can add a small probe that compares labels and scaling separately and classifies severity.
maria: And add a cost estimate field to the drift detector output so approvers know scale impact.
alex.nguyen: Thanks team — tracking on infra ticket INFRA-4821. Will update thread after PR and reconcile. :thumbsup:
